scored.name: Pairidex
scored.subcategory: Diagnostics — molecular monitoring of measurable residual disease in blood cancers
scored.founders: Andrew Young, MD, PhD, physician-scientist at Washington University School of Medicine and Pairidex’s founder and CSO. BioSTL says Pairidex was co-founded by BioGenerator. Paul Kortschak is CEO; the sources reviewed do not identify him as a founder.
scored.description: FusionMRD is a personalized RNA-based droplet digital PCR test that uses a peripheral blood sample to detect and monitor measurable residual disease in gene-fusion-driven blood cancers. The company says it is commercially available through its CAP-accredited, CLIA-certified laboratory.
scored.evidence: Pairidex reported that FusionMRD was commercially available by July 2026. A Pairidex summary of a peer-reviewed Haematologica observational study reports personalized assays for 20 patients and testing of 133 samples; in all seven patients with serial samples who experienced treatment failure, the test detected fusion transcripts before standard testing or clinical progression, with a median lead time of 92 days. This is early clinical evidence, not evidence of improved patient outcomes.

source_notes.supports: July 27, 2026 seed financing of $4.89 million; St. Louis, Missouri location; RNA-based FusionMRD description and commercial availability.

scored.name: Hepta Bio
scored.subcategory: Diagnostics — cfDNA-based, AI-enabled detection of MASH and liver fibrosis
scored.round_date: November 5, 2025 (announced; financing instrument not specified in the sources)
scored.founders: Hamed Amini, Ph.D. (CEO and co-founder), previously at Illumina and GRAIL; and Soheil Damangir, Ph.D. (CTO and co-founder), previously at GRAIL and Google AI.
scored.description: LiquidTransformer, an AI platform that analyzes epigenetic patterns in cell-free DNA from blood to infer tissue-level biology. Hepta is initially focused on non-invasive detection of MASH and liver fibrosis, with broader chronic-disease applications described by the company.
scored.evidence: Hepta reported a diagnostic AUC of 0.86 for identifying MASH patients with significant fibrosis, with threefold fewer false positives than standard blood tests. GenomeWeb also reported proof-of-concept evidence that cfDNA methylation signatures in blood correspond to liver-tissue biology. In May 2026, the company reported SAMARA trial sample analyses in which baseline cfDNA methylation distinguished future semaglutide weight-loss responders from non-responders; this was company-announced conference data. These are reported research findings, not evidence here of regulatory clearance or routine clinical deployment.

source_notes.supports: Official company website and product description: LiquidTransformer analyzes cfDNA epigenetic patterns; initial focus is MASH.

scored.name: Senticell
scored.subcategory: Diagnostics — liquid biopsy for cancer detection and monitoring
scored.round_amount: Approaching $7 million; reported as $7 million by company-profile sources
scored.founders: Neha Shah, co-founder and CEO, is a former GEP co-founder and president and a Wharton graduate. Nilam Mangalmurti, MD, scientific co-founder and chief scientific advisor, is a physician-scientist and associate professor at the University of Pennsylvania whose research identified red-blood-cell binding of nucleic acids.
scored.description: A liquid-biopsy platform that isolates and analyzes nucleic acids associated with red blood cells to identify cancer-related signals, including mutations that plasma-based tests may miss. The platform is initially focused on oncology and early-stage or low-shedding cancers.
scored.evidence: The company reports prospective oncology studies underway with Penn Medicine; one external report describes studies expected to enroll about 300 patients. Senticell also announced a September 2026 National Cancer Institute STTR Phase I grant to support preclinical work and evaluation in 100 patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer. These indicate research and clinical-validation activity, not confirmed diagnostic performance: I found no reported clinical results establishing the test’s accuracy or clinical utility.

impact_and_health_equity.rationale: Earlier detection of cancers that may be missed by plasma-based tests could improve outcomes, but the record provides no performance results, access or affordability evidence, or demonstrated benefit for underserved populations.
